Creating a pull request doesn't just mean pushing code; it means following team rules, issue templates, and contribution guidelines. Thankfully, you can use a defined skill in the GitHub Copilot CLI to handle all of this automatically. Watch how Copilot scans your repository to create the perfect PR without manual formatting. To see this in action, check out our full Copilot CLI for beginners series: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BDxRhhs36ns&list=PL0lo9MOBetEHvO-spzKBAITkkTqv4RvNl
